ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixel distribution occupying approximately 85% of the visible surface area, contrasted by low-intensity (black) pixels localized at the margins and median axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity perimeter banding on all trailing and leading edges. Irregular low-intensity splotch at the median notch intersection. Distinct circular low-intensity focal spots located in the medial-right lobe and medial-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate 50-degree interior angle with a deep vertical bounding-box recession toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits small, consistent pixel-amplitude oscillations. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits larger, jagged, non-uniform peaks and deep valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges transitioning to tapered, slightly blunt distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of high-contrast dark clusters on the white field: one prominent spot on the mid-left lobe, two small spots on the mid-right lobe, and dense clusters at the extreme distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Asymmetric, ragged trailing edge on the left lobe suggesting previous physical trauma or non-uniform wear compared to the smoother right lobe topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined, dark 'hourglass' or 'Y' shaped pigmentation pattern at the central fluke-to-peduncle transition.
